messages:
emily.docs: Heads up — docs PR #2468: the generate endpoint examples only show boolean values for `dry_run` (true/false). Runtime actually accepts a tri-state: true, false, or the string "auto".

emily.docs: This is causing downstream SDK tests to fail when example payloads use "auto". Need coordination: docs + OpenAPI + Go SDK fix.

mark.api: Can you paste the failing request and error from CI?

emily.docs: Sure — here's the curl we used in examples:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge-gen","prompt":"summarize...","dry_run":"auto"}'
```
Server response: 400 Bad Request {"error":"invalid type for field 'dry_run': expected boolean"}

sita-sdk: I saw the CI failure. The Go SDK currently defines GenerateParams.DryRun as `bool`. Go's JSON marshal can't represent "auto". JS/Python clients accept strings so they pass through.

luis-eng: Runtime clarification: "auto" is intentional and stable — it triggers cost/latency heuristics (will run quick-check logic). We already accept true/false/"auto". We should update the OpenAPI spec to enumerate [true,false,"auto"] and clarify semantics.

mark.api: Okay — plan: runtime updates OpenAPI enum and examples; docs update adds migration note and revised examples; SDKs (Go) change type to a tri-state-compatible type.

sita-sdk: I'll open a Go SDK PR to switch DryRun to `type DryRunOption string` with consts `DryRunTrue`, `DryRunFalse`, `DryRunAuto` and update marshaling helpers. Will include a changelog entry and a small snippet showing usage. ETA: 6h.

emily.docs: I'll update API ref examples (curl, python, js) and add a migration guide section called "dry_run tri-state" that explains why auto exists and how to handle it in typed SDKs. Will ping for review.

ci-bot: CI: docs PR #2468 lint OK, integration tests failed: go-sdk-integration/TestGenerateWithAuto — see https://ci.internal/rdw/2468/job/1234 (log attached).

mark.api: Action items: 1) @luis-eng update OpenAPI (enum + example) 2) @sita-sdk open Go SDK PR + changelog 3) @emily.docs patch docs + migration note 4) I'll coordinate merges and schedule a short post-merge smoke test. Target: today EOD.

emily.docs: :thumbsup: I'll also add a tiny code sample for Go showing use of the new enum so customers see the right pattern.

sita-sdk: Thanks — will include example and add a compatibility note for teams pinning the old boolean type.

mark.api: Thanks all — looping in runtime/SDK/docs until resolved.
